i.norm: Verifies that a BoundedIterator can be constructed with a large, equal offset and max. Because the decorated iterator is empty (hasNext() is mocked to return false), the constructor's internal advance-to-offset loop performs no element access, so construction completes without error.
SwitchClosure with an empty case map is accepted (no behavioural effect here).
An empty decorated iterator: hasNext() always reports no remaining elements.
